crossRefs.note: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,
He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.
translations.bsb: So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe,
translations.kjv: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
